description: Mints a key for one run's runner: it reaches ONLY that run's machines, volumes and networks, everything it creates joins the run, it works only through this MCP (connect with the header Authorization: Bearer <key>), and it is deleted when the run ends. Use it instead of an account key for an agent that works inside a run. Usage is billed to the account. The key is shown once. Needs a logged-in session or a full-access key; a run key cannot mint one.

expires_in_hours.description: Optional lifetime in hours, 1 to 168 (7 days). Default 24.

id.description: The run's id, from create_run or list_runs.

name: create_run_key
title: Create run key
